page.intro: Since ipecharts 1.4.2 a chart watches its own container and draws again when the container changes size or becomes visible. Each context below mounts a chart with no resize code. Change the layout and check that the chart follows.

column.title: 1. A plain page column
column.description: Resize the window: the chart follows.

width.title: 2. A container that changes width
width.description: The card goes from half width to full width without a window resize.

panel.title: 3. Inside a collapsed panel
panel.description: The chart is built when the panel opens.

tabs.title: 4. On a tab nobody has opened
tabs.description: The chart is built the first time the tab is shown.

right_panel.title: 5. MapApp's right panel
right_panel.description: Close the panel and open it again.

panel.title: Charts
panel.description: Contexts 5 to 7 live here: this panel, the dialog step in the drawer, and the chart button on the map. The chart on the map is built inside a hidden menu and takes its size when the menu opens.
